segments.text: Wait. Oh, yeah, I remember now. Well, I wonder who's here. Or was that you?
Because you typed Sega as soon as you, uh...
Was that you with the anonymous or was that shanky?
Because you started doing an anonymous lately too.
What is this mine? True. Thank you. Thank you for damaging my ear drums, too. Thank you. Catch you later. Catch you in a bit.
